failed_metadata_page.failure: too many HTTP 429 responses after the frozen retry policy

subsequent_resume_failure.failure: The metadata service remained unavailable after the frozen retries.

impact.summary: The first interrupted run downloaded no new payload. The cache-first retry then made deterministic forward progress to 1,758 validated images before another transient metadata failure. Both interruptions preserved complete asset/receipt pairs, left no partial files, and did not change the frozen sample, reserve order or rejection journal.

remediation.cache_first_resume: A fully cached pair is reconstructed and revalidated from its local asset plus receipt before any metadata request.
remediation.fail_closed_checks: The frozen row formula, label, generator, pinned canonical path and receipt schema are revalidated; the exact file byte count and SHA-256 must match the receipt finalized after the original successful decode, after which the recorded decoded-pixel and perceptual identities are restored without repeating image decoding.
remediation.receipt_trust_boundary: The committed resume lock anchors the first 680 receipts; later finalized receipts are trusted local runtime state.
remediation.post_acquisition_requirement: Run one full-decode integrity audit over every accepted image before E6 training.
